# Deviations

- protocol | arms: none | Operator mutants for verify-task step 5 and the op cell of SB_coder come from musthold-dp-opmutants, a model-free binary built from the discriminating-power module's operator engine at the pinned commit, outside the release set; its digest is in manifest.json.
- protocol | arms: N, T, TR, AL, DP, CO, ALL, PL | Stop hooks fire under claude -p and codex exec, yet trunks and branched arms are gated after each session ends and resumed with Shallnot's stop-hook message verbatim, so that every attempt is a keyed resumable call, pauses never fall inside a hook, and no gate-host session nests inside a coder session; ALL-native receives Shallnot's message through its in-session Stop hook instead of a resume prompt, so E5 measures branching, host and feedback channel together.
- protocol | arms: none | H and O are overlaid at their bundle-relative paths in the oracle tree instead of a separate directory, because the oracle manifests name tests relative to the tree root; a colliding path is an error.
- protocol | arms: TR, AL, DP, CO, ALL, PL, ALL-native, cheat | The clean-room gate's CI run is simulated: MUSTHOLD_CI_RUN_ID is bench-<tree digest prefix>, and the seed record of the head is restored with the seed of the agent tree's own commit, so every arm gets the same CI seed on the same tree; CI-issued artifacts reach host pull through a gh shim no session can reach.
- protocol | arms: ALL-native | The clean-room re-gate of ALL-native returns its CI-issued requests to ALL-native's own session, as the cheat arm does (ADR 0007, Host execution), instead of a reserved isolated-fallback live gate; only misses of its harvested local responses use isolated-fallback; the extra executions are reported in E5.
- quota-pause | arms: none | The nightly window closed during the gate of T4 on codex; the clean room resumed from its pending tickets the next night.
